candidates.change_summary: Return false instead of true at the end of the function.
Remove the require(_tos.length > 0) check so the function can be called with an empty array and still return true.
Remove the require(_s) success check inside the loop so that a failing internal call does not revert the transaction.
Remove the entire loop body so no external calls are made, affecting the return true behavior only when the array length requirement is bypassed.
Replace `return true;` with `return false;` so the function returns false instead of true after a successful execution.
Replace `require(_tos.length > 0)` with `require(_tos.length == 0)` to revert on any non-empty input.
